text: {"rulings": [{"id": "1", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Websockets carrying live positions and vessels pinging every 15 minutes describe different parts of the tracking pipeline and are both true at once."}, {"id": "2", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The dev server port has nothing to do with how often vessels ping."}, {"id": "3", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The definition of a route as an ordered list of seaports is untouched by the vessel ping interval."}, {"id": "4", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The API rate limit per key and the vessel ping interval are separate settings that can both hold."}, {"id": "5", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The Fly.io deployment region is independent of the vessel ping interval."}]}
